content: प्रतिज्ञा €9 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To promise, declare solemnly, engage, agree, vow; हरचापारोपणेन कन्यादानं प्रतिजानीते <ls>P. R. 4</ls>. .²2 To state, affirm, assert, maintain, allege. .²3 To bring forward or introduce, adduce. .²4 To admit, own, acknowledge. .²5 To confirm. .²6 To approve, consent. .²7 To observe, learn, discern. .²8 To propose. .²9 To remember with regret. .²10 To become aware of; कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति <ls>Bg. 9. 31</ls>.

प्रतिज्ञा .²1 Admission, acknowledgment. .²2 A vow, promise, engagement, solemn declaration; दैवात् तीर्णप्रतिज्ञः <ls>Mu. 4. 12</ls>; तीर्त्वा जवेनैव नितान्तदुस्तरां नदीं प्रतिज्ञामिव तां गरीयसीम् <ls>Śi. 12. 74</ls>. .²3 A statement, assertion, declaration, affirmation. .²4 (In Nyāya <ab>phil.</ab>) A proposition, statement of the proposition to be proved, the first member of the five-membered Indian syllogism; साध्यनिर्देशः प्रतिज्ञा यथा पर्वतो वह्निमान् <ls>Gaut. S.</ls>; see under न्याय; (पर्वतो वह्निमान् is the usual instance). .²5 (In Law) A plaint, an indictment.
